common: Review the service against README.md. Do not edit or delegate beyond the four assigned leaf reviews. Every child may inspect every source module and trace dependencies. Request each child summary at most 5000 characters. Fan out once before consuming findings, then fan in once logically. After fan-in, deduplicate by causal meaning and produce one final list with locations, triggering conditions, expected versus actual behavior, and causal explanations or reproducers. Do not perform another source-review phase after fan-in. Include supported bugs only; exclude style and speculation. Do not steer or replace children. Required discovery and all launch/wait text are counted.
goal: Review the public service in work/src against work/README.md; trace dependencies across files. No edits, no further delegation. Return concrete supported-path findings with trigger, cause, expected/actual behavior and optional reproducer; summary <=5000 characters.

mechanisms.B-briefed: Call delegate_task once with tasks containing the four exact brief+goal+scope payloads above, role=leaf, background=false. Supply each brief exactly once. Consume the returned batch, then synthesize.
mechanisms.C: Call teammate_assign for contracts, state, boundaries, errors in one assistant tool-call batch; role briefs are installed once in those roles. Use the identical goal and scope above as each goal, without repeating the installed brief. Then teammate_wait(run_ids=[all four],mode=all,wait_seconds=60) until pending is empty, repeating the full ID set on timeout. Do not use teammate_check, roster discovery or intermediate synthesis. Then synthesize.
